topic: country gioi han 1 quoc gia; de trong = mo cho tat ca
statement: Theo tai lieu `qikfiliate/Domain Entities` Section: PaymentMethod (corroborate boi `admin - invoices and payment methods` Section: Payment Method va Journey - Them 1 phuong thuc thanh toan moi), field country gioi han phuong thuc nay chi cho affiliate o 1 quoc gia; de trong (null) nghia la moi quoc gia deu thay. Field nay CHI nhan 1 quoc gia, KHONG nhan ca khu vuc. Muon mo 1 phuong thuc cho nhieu quoc gia, phai tao nhieu dong Payment Method rieng (moi dong 1 quoc gia, cung ten nhung khac country), hoac de trong country de mo cho tat ca.

confirmation_source.ref: qikfiliate/admin - invoices and payment methods (04-invoices-and-payment-methods.md) v1 Section: Invoices & Payment Methods (màn hình Invoice, Payment Method) > Payment Method — danh sách phương thức khả dụng cho affiliate chọn

topic: Gioi han thiet ke hien tai: khong co kieu 'danh sach nhieu quoc gia' trong 1 dong
statement: Theo tai lieu `admin - invoices and payment methods` Section: Journey - Them 1 phuong thuc thanh toan moi, day la gioi han thiet ke hien tai cua he thong: khong co kieu 'danh sach nhieu quoc gia' trong 1 dong Payment Method (phai tach nhieu dong - xem KB-004). Tai lieu tu danh dau claim nay la hedged (chua chac chan/chua xac nhan).
